title: the walk knows the positions of every form it meets, and a form it does not know is a defect of its own
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track A (the wave A3) for the fifth time: the discriminator of the package of the waves 87 to 89 named one finding that touches it (F27, high), and the review of the wave 90 named three more classes of the same family beside it.  The code of the kernel is honest; the proof was not.  The wave touches no code of the kernel.  (1) **The walk read a name in a position where a name stands as a call, and the class was not closed**: the objection (a) of wave 90 said that the kernel holds no such position today, and that was false -- the kernel holds 55 `when-let', `if-let' and `*when-let' and 3 `cl-labels' that the closed list of five positions did not name; the escape was green: on a tree where the runtime takes the move `idle --user-prompt--> deciding' no more, the check answered 0.  The same report named two of the five positions wrongly: at a `cl-defmethod' it is the name of the variable of the specializer that was read as a call, and at a `cl-defgeneric' it is the names of the arguments, not the doc string; and the probe of 39 cases that the note of wave 90 pointed at was not in the repository, so it could not be run again.  (2) **A form that the walk does not know is a defect of its own**: the table of the positions knew five kinds of positions and the kernel holds more; the wave taught the walk the positions of every form it meets -- the special forms of Emacs are read out of Emacs itself, the macros of the kernel are read out of the files of the kernel, and the forms the walk meets are read out of the walk itself -- and a macro or a special form that the table does not know is named by its file and its line and answers with the code 1.  (3) **The body of a local function that nobody calls is not code the runtime runs**: the walk went into the body of every local function of a `cl-labels' or of a `cl-flet', so a tick that stood in a body nobody calls was a place of the runtime; the walk goes into the body of a local function whose name stands in the code of the form -- a call of it, a call of it from a neighbouring local function, or its name as a value that the runtime calls.  (4) **A name in data is data**: the rule of the local functions asked the question of the name with a structural search that did not tell code from data, so a name in a quoted form was read as a mention and the body of the function was walked; the rule asks now the same question the global walk asks -- does the runtime call this name?  A name in a code position is a call, a value the runtime calls (`funcall', `apply', `#'') is a call, and a name in a quoted form that nobody calls is data.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about the runtime: the walk reads the **words of the code** of the kernel and not the trace of the runtime.  The price is named and it is three prices.  (a) The table of the positions is written by hand -- 74 entries and 20 kinds of positions -- and the kinds are the kinds the check names: the table is **measured** against the kernel and not asserted (every special form of Emacs, every macro of the kernel and every form the walk meets must be in the table), but a kind that names the wrong parts of a form reads the wrong parts as code.  (b) The walk reads the **code** of the files of the kernel and not the trace of the runtime: a name that is computed at runtime (`(funcall (intern "witness"))') is not seen, and that is named.  (c) The rule of the local functions and the rule of the global walk are not the same rule: the global walk reads the designator `#'foo' as a name (so a global definition that only `#'' reaches is dead for the runtime), and the local rule counts `#'witness' as a call.  That is the conservative side -- it gives no false refusals -- and the global semantics did not change, so the numbers of the report did not move either.  (d) The asymmetry is named and not papered over: the walk of a local function whose name is computed at runtime reads it as uncalled, and the local rule is about `cl-labels' and `cl-flet' only; the other scopes (the values of the functions of a `pcase-let*', the bodies of a `cl-defmethod') live as they lived.
refuted_by: a name that stands in a position where a name stands is read as a call, or a form that the walk meets is not in the table of the positions, or a macro of the kernel is not in the table of the positions, or a special form of Emacs is not in the table of the positions, or the body of a local function that the runtime never calls is read as code of the runtime, or a name in a quoted form is read as a call, or the walk measures the table differently than it measured it before, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `every-transition-of-the-table-is-taken' is the same, the text says that the walk knows the positions of every form it meets, that a form it does not know is a defect of its own, and that the body of a local function that nobody calls is not code the runtime runs; the `falsifier' names the new refusals, and the `control' is the same.  Seventeen controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-21 by the writer of the wave (the last sweep of the writer, on the last commit of the branch) and nine more by the parent, and the parent's nine were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, and the numbers unchanged: 23 places of a tick, 23 of them live, 14 name the state of the run and 9 do not, 15 cells rest on a place that says nothing about the state, 2 fans, 55 macros and special forms met and 55 of them known, 558 live definitions.  (2) **The finding F27 itself**: a name in a position where a name stands -- the `when-let' of the kernel -- made a definition that nobody calls a root of the runtime, and the check answered 0; now the code 1, and the check names the cell that the runtime does not take.  (3) The same class in the other positions the kernel holds: `cl-labels', `destructuring-bind' and the doc string of a `cl-defgeneric' -- the code 1 in all three.  (4) **The controls of the parent, made independently**: the control of the claim -- the code 1; a macro of the kernel that the table of the positions does not know -- the code 1, and the macro is named by its file and its line.  (5) **Two classes that the parent found after the first version of the wave**: the body of a local function that nobody calls was read as a place of the runtime -- the code 0, a false green, and now the code 1; and the name of a local function that stands only in a quoted form was read as a mention -- the code 0, a false green, and now the code 1.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 2364 lines and 115.6 kB (the wave 90 one was 1602 lines and 78.3 kB); the files of the kernel were not touched by this wave, and the branch holds seven commits.
